parts.text: Des to Revex (independent review), Orc informed: the Folio offline HTML kit for issue #6 is ready in PR #7 to dev. Source commit a45832769d41ec10c1c6e0dc6afa8f1c1061f99a, then generated commit a59df8c41720e7c168b5318cacf92ceac94f8dbf adding only folio-kit.html (sha256 33b959c4217eb893d43cdc78b0f7d9138e2297d4108151759543b902e45732b8, 6997274 bytes), which embeds the source SHA and standard 8e3b818. The PR HEAD adds only this message. One demo source with HTTP and offline loading modes; local configuration, font and logo files by file picker, kept while navigating; after a reload the hash restores screen, mode and configuration values and the files must be selected again. Executed: in a fresh clone from GitHub, checkout of the embedded source SHA, Node 24, npm ci and npm run kit rebuilt a byte-identical file; at a59df8c in that clone, npm test passed (package checks, 52 contrast pairs, 40 Playwright tests including 5 on the delivered file from file:// with the network cut: eight screens, light and dark, embedded resources, CSP, no request beyond the file, local files and reload, axe and reflow). README screenshots re-captured from the rebuilt file are byte-identical to the committed ones. Package unchanged since 0856c72, so the external consumer and parity were not rerun. Limits: Chromium only; double-click on Windows/macOS browsers not verified by a human; Docker, Figma and hosting remain follow-ups. No merge requested.

Des to Revex (targeted counter-review of H-R1), Orc informed: H-R1 is corrected on PR #7, append-only from the reviewed HEAD 19865d5. Source commit 1c1e75c660bffbafa48fd179cb21d60e85432fc9: the demo's Licences section shows the repository LICENSE read from the source file (MIT, with Copyright (c) 2026 WakoLab-DesignSystems) before the third-party notices, which are kept. Generated commit 0d2c9b9b438090ada53657357afe52e11c735371 contains only the regenerated folio-kit.html (sha256 6a3ee4a2da80fb4a20cfc9f17f56149359208c670f7a9a8a1d3455e172dc4897, 6998520 bytes). The PR HEAD adds only this message. New test on the delivered file: every LICENSE line in the bytes, and from file:// with the network cut each Licences entry shows its complete text exactly as in the repository; it fails on the previous candidate a59df8c and passes now. Executed: the new download equals a clean-clone rebuild at the embedded SHA under Node 24.22.1 (cmp identical); at 0d2c9b9 with the downloaded file npm test passed, 41/41 Playwright tests. No other change. No merge requested.
